• Brand introduction: Stylish Security in Eco-Friendly Fence, Eco-friendly, private, safe and comfortable, growing with you.
• Product description:

6 ft. H x 6 ft. W x 0.8 in Outdoor Privacy Composite Fence

The fence can be made into a straight line or in a 90 degree corner.

Easy-to-follow instructions and online support.

This fence kit comes with Everything You Need to construct your privacy Composite Fence, including all weather, wood grain composite boards, 9 boards per 6′ section. Boards are 1″x8″x6′.  FREE SHIPPING!

Includes
  • Fence posts
  • Wood grain composite boards
  • Post bases
  • Post caps
  • Post Covers
  • Concrete anchor bolts
  • Post Caps

  1. Fence panels are composed of wood, high-density polyethylene, and special materials. They are durable, long-lasting, and eco-friendly.

  2. Low maintenance, fence panels are resistant to corrosion, rust and harsh weather conditions. No oiling or painting is required and they can last up to 15 years.

  3. Privacy Fences have excellent UV resistance to keep their appearance and color for a long time.

  4. Fence panels have a strong anchor system that can withstand hurricane force winds (tested at wind speeds of 80-95Km/h) and remain stable in extreme weather conditions.

  5. Excellent waterproofing performance, ideal for areas prone to rain and snow.

  6. The fence is made of wood and has a natural wood grain texture, perfect for modern patio styles.

  7. The fence can be easily assembled and expanded with three slots for fence posts that you can install in a straight line, at right angles or in a "T" shape. Detailed installation instructions are included in the product package.

• Other information:

Line Post Description

The post and cap are made from high durable aluminum, powder coated black, which will remain unaffected by UV rays, high humidity, as well as temperature fluctuations. This line post is compatible with fence boards of up to 0.8″ thickness.  Features 3 channel grooves so the fence can be made into a straight line or in a 90 degree corner.

Line Post Specifications

Color: Black

Material: Aluminum, steel

Post dimensions: 2.8″ x 2.8″ x 72.8″ (W x D x H)

Base size: 4.7″ x 4.7″ (L x W)

Compatible with included fence boards

Assembly required: Yes


WHAT IS WOOD PLASTIC COMPOSITE (WPC)?

  • Composite fences: Made from a blend of wood fibers and plastic, composite fence offers the look of wood without the maintenance. It doesn’t require painting or staining and is resistant to fading, warping, and insects. Composite fences come in various styles and colors. various styles and colors.
  • This WPC board utilizes extrusion molding technology to produce a co-extruded Wood Plastic Composite (WPC) fence board. The polymer shield of the WPC board evenly and firmly covers the extruded core.
  • Co-Extrusion retains the advantages of traditional WPC such as mildew and insect resistant, abrasion resistant, scratch resistant, stain resistant and weather proof. However, some properties are even better. The experimental data proves that the wear and scratch resistance of the co-extruded WPC boards are more than five times stronger than that of the first-generation mono-extruded WPC fence boards.
